# NT51951 CtrlRAM Replace Handoff

No direct product CtrlRAM golden is currently committed. Provide the same file
shape as NT51950 for each selected single/cascade mode; exact filenames and
sizes are listed in the root [`TODO.md`](../../TODO.md).

Alternatively, the firmware owner may approve an exact NT51950-to-NT51951
CtrlRAM fact alias naming mode and Common FW version. The existing general
postbuild-family confirmation does not by itself replace a direct product
golden or mode-specific approval.
